name: io.github.mordor-forge/gemini-media-mcp
title: Gemini Media
description: Generate images (Nano Banana), video (Veo), speech and music (Lyria) with Google's Gemini models

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Gemini API key from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey. Optional when using Vertex AI or a key saved with `gemini-media-mcp configure --api-key-stdin`.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Vertex AI project ID (uses Application Default Credentials instead of an API key).

environmentVariables.name: MEDIA_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory where generated media is saved.

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_MEDIA_BUDGET_DAILY_USD
environmentVariables.description: Refuse new generations once today's estimated spend reaches this many US dollars (0 = no cap).

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Host directory that receives generated media, mounted at /output in the container.

host_output_dir.description: Absolute path of a host directory for generated media (for example /home/you/generated_media).

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Named volume that keeps the spend ledger, budgets and video jobs across container runs, mounted at /state.

runtimeArguments.name: -e
runtimeArguments.description: Save generated media to the mounted /output volume.

runtimeArguments.name: -e
runtimeArguments.description: Optional daily spend cap in US dollars (0 = no cap).
